name: Entropy of dynamical systems from information theory
summary: Shannon's entropy is turned into an isomorphism invariant of measure-preserving transformations, settling that Bernoulli shifts with different entropy are not isomorphic.

name: Etale cohomology
summary: Grothendieck topologies gave cohomology theories for varieties over finite fields as required by Weil.

name: Hyperfunctions and algebraic analysis
summary: Sato defines hyperfunctions as boundary values of holomorphic functions and develops microlocal methods.

name: Kodaira-Spencer deformation theory
summary: Deformations of complex structures were studied by cohomology.

name: Several complex variables via PDE
summary: L2 estimates for the d-bar equation solved problems about pseudoconvex domains.

name: Topological K-theory
summary: Vector bundle classes formed a generalised cohomology theory, used on Hopf invariant and index problems.

name: Kripke semantics
summary: Relational models gave completeness theorems for modal logics.

name: Random graphs
summary: Graphs chosen at random were studied for thresholds of properties.

name: Restricted Burnside problem
summary: Zelmanov used Lie ring methods to show finitely many finite quotients exist for exponent n.

name: Morse theory and handle decompositions prove high-dimensional Poincare
summary: Gradient flows of Morse functions give handle decompositions, and cancellation of handles proves the generalised Poincare conjecture in dimensions at least five.
